So gamer goats, what are you picking up and why? Here's my list:

  • Doom (2016) - It looks awesome and I've only heard good things about it. It's been out for about a month and a half now and it's on sale for $35.99, I'm not passing that up.

  • Doom Classic Complete - I used to own all of these when I was a kid and for some reason I don't own them now. Chalk this up to nostalgia I guess.

  • Metro Redux Bundle - A TotalBiscuit recommendation and I've had my eye on this for a while.

  • The Swapper - Another TB recommendation.

  • Serious Sam HD: Double Pack - I've never played any of these but they look interesting. Another TB recommendation, and this looks like a fun game for co-op.

  • Saints Row IV - I haven't played any in this series but I'm looking forward to the penetrator and co-op.

  • Transistor - Another TB recommendation.

  • Goat Simulator: GOATY - It's got goats, nuff said.

  • The Stanley Parable - Another TB recommendation.

  • Contrast - The trailer for We Happy Few caused me to look into other games this dev created. Contrast looks interesting and it got good reviews.

  • Wolfenstein: The Old Blood - I really liked The New Order so I'm getting this.

  • Tales From The Borderlands - I liked The Wolf Among Us and The Walking Dead games and I also liked Borderlands.

  • Game of Thrones - A Telltale Games Series - It's Game of Thrones and, as previously mentioned, I liked the other games I've played from this dev.

I know, "Some dude on the internet recommended it" is a dumb reason to buy a game but they're cheap and mostly by indy devs which I like to support. TB's list if anyone is wondering.
